usageNote: 短语用法，说人'一辈子都在做某事'，语气带点感慨，聊人生经历超好用！

examples.en: They have lived in this small town their whole lives.
examples.zh: 他们一辈子都住在这个小镇上。

examples.en: Some people work hard their whole lives but never feel satisfied.
examples.zh: 有些人奋斗了一辈子，却从未感到满足。
